labels.wrongElement: hints[0] (kind "translation": vocabulary gloss «la cartera — гаманець») lists the grammar target object-pron.lo-la/written-form in its targets
labels.expectedFinding: A vocabulary gloss supports no grammar target; mapping it to the pronoun target would record pronoun support (and postpone independent credit) whenever the learner only needed the word.
por qué (preposition + interrogative) introduces the question; porque (conjunction, 'because') introduces the reason.

labels.wrongElement: rule hint: "Назви днів тижня в іспанській завжди пишуться з великої літери… Lunes, Martes, Jueves"
labels.expectedFinding: Names of days, months and seasons are common nouns and are written in lowercase as a general rule.

labels.wrongElement: clip translationUk and the translation hint render «a mediodía» as "через пів дня" (in half a day) instead of "опівдні" (at noon)
labels.expectedFinding: mediodía denotes a moment (noon, the central hours of the day); medio día denotes a duration (half a day).

labels.wrongElement: the prompt does not say whether the guests are addressed as vosotros (friends/family) or ustedes (formal); the closed key accepts only «Siéntense» and marks «Sentaos» incorrect
labels.expectedFinding: Spanish has two plural forms of address, vosotros and ustedes; the vosotros reflexive imperative is levantaos/duchaos and the ustedes one levántense/dúchense, so both «Sentaos» and «Siéntense» fit depending on the unstated relationship.

labels.wrongElement: rule hint: "…завжди пишеться з тильдою над í: … construído, incluído" (over-general rule with wrong examples); the key «leído» itself is correct
labels.expectedFinding: Participles of -uir verbs (construido, incluido) carry no tilde (-ui- is a diphthong in llanas); the hint's 'always' rule and examples are false.
«ayer tarde» is perfectly appropriate (DPD), alongside ayer por la tarde.

labels.wrongElement: accepted variant v2 "Se las" (noteUk: plural of «vecinos» may move to the pronoun) is accepted as correct for one key given to several people
labels.expectedFinding: One thing given to several people is «se la/se lo»; moving the plural onto the direct-object pronoun («se las») is strongly rejected in European Spanish.

labels.wrongElement: the Ukrainian prompt «Ви вже поїли?» (sentence-initial capital) can be polite singular or plural; the closed key accepts only vosotros forms and would mark «¿Ya ha comido?» (usted) or «¿Ya han comido?» (ustedes) incorrect
labels.expectedFinding: Ukrainian ви is used to address two or more people or, politely, one person (СУМ); Spanish distinguishes usted, vosotros and ustedes, and the prompt does not say which applies.

labels.wrongElement: error variant e1 "Iros" marked incorrect, with feedback claiming it is only an infinitive with a pronoun
labels.expectedFinding: «Idos» is the recommended vosotros imperative of irse, but the Academia also considers the widespread variant «iros» valid.
In the 12-hour model the part of the day is specified with de la mañana / de la tarde / de la noche; «a las ocho de la tarde» is 20:00.

labels.wrongElement: the sentence gives no time frame or discourse context, so «trabajaba» (ongoing/habitual) and «trabajó» (completed period) are both defensible; the key accepts only «trabajaba» and its feedback asserts a habitual reading the prompt does not establish
labels.expectedFinding: The imperfecto presents past facts in their course, the indefinido as finished; without context both views of 'my grandfather worked in a factory' are possible.
«coger el autobús/ascensor» and «tomar…» are both correct; coger is only to be avoided in some American countries.

labels.wrongElement: the task assesses the vosotros form («Vosotros ___» → «habláis») although only yo/tú/él-ella-usted forms have been taught at this point
labels.expectedFinding: Teach before testing: plural person forms (including vosotros) are not in the taught list, so the item assesses an untaught person form.

labels.wrongElement: accepted key "vió", error variant "vio" marked incorrect, and the hint/feedback teaching a tilde on «vio»
labels.expectedFinding: dio, vio, fue (and di, vi, fui) are written without a tilde because they are orthographic monosyllables.

labels.wrongElement: option b feedbackUk "Ця слово жіночого роду…": wrong gender agreement in Ukrainian (слово is neuter: «Це слово»)
labels.expectedFinding: Ukrainian «слово» is a neuter noun (СУМ: «СЛОВО, а, с.»), so the demonstrative must be «це», not feminine «ця».
With la mayoría de + plural noun, both singular and plural verb agreement are adequate (plural more usual); no attribute/predicative here.
In -ducir verbs the stem c becomes j in the indefinido: condujo, not «condució».

labels.wrongElement: accepted answers "3,02" and "3.02" do not match the transcript «tres euros con veinte» (3,20 €)
labels.expectedFinding: «tres euros con veinte» is 3,20 €; the key accepts 3,02 and the correct amount would only be unresolved.

labels.wrongElement: "Por la mañana" does not say whether the morning belongs to today (still-open period, perfecto expected in Spain) or to an earlier day (indefinido); the closed key accepts only «he llamado» and marks «llamé» incorrect
labels.expectedFinding: The perfecto refers to a past action within a period not yet finished, often an implicit one such as 'the current day'; the prompt does not fix that period, so «llamé» cannot be ruled out.
Interrogative dónde carries a tilde, and omitting the opening question mark is considered a spelling error.

labels.wrongElement: «le» in «Ana le da un diccionario» can refer to Pablo or to the professor (both present, both singular); the key accepts only "Професорові Руїсу" and option feedback asserts that reading
labels.expectedFinding: le is the indirect-object pronoun for a singular recipient of either gender; the sentence offers two singular candidates and nothing selects one.
Compound tenses use the haber form «ha» (with h) + participle: «ha llamado», not «a llamado».

labels.wrongElement: the isolated clip «A ver.» is homophonous with «Haber.» and gives no context; the closed key accepts only «A ver.»
labels.expectedFinding: a ver and haber are homophones (they sound the same); an isolated clip cannot show which spelling is intended.

labels.wrongElement: the task asks for the indefinido of the irregular verb «ir» (answer «fui») in an A2-04-L1 regular -ar task targeting indefinido.regular-ar
labels.expectedFinding: Only regular -ar indefinido forms are taught at this point; «fui» is an irregular form of ir/ser that is not taught yet and is not a regular -ar form, so it cannot be assessed under this target.

labels.wrongElement: «a las ocho» has no part-of-day complement (de la mañana/tarde/noche) and no other context; the key accepts only "О 20:00" and marks "О 8:00" incorrect
labels.expectedFinding: In the 12-hour model the part of the day is given by de la mañana/de la tarde/de la noche; without it «a las ocho» can be 8:00 or 20:00.
The RAE considers «andé» incorrect; the correct form is «anduve».

labels.wrongElement: «La llamo» can refer to Marta or to Lucía (both feminine singular candidates); the key accepts only "Марті"
labels.expectedFinding: la is the feminine singular direct-object pronoun; it does not identify which of two feminine singular referents is meant.

labels.wrongElement: option a "Так, працює" is marked correct and option b "Ні, не працює" incorrect, contradicting the transcript «Los domingos no abrimos»
labels.expectedFinding: The transcript states the shop does not open on Sundays; the key marks the opposite answer correct.

labels.wrongElement: prompt block 2 shows the full Spanish transcript before the learner answers an independent listening-meaning question
labels.expectedFinding: An audio-only meaning question must not display the transcript; showing it turns the listening target into reading and removes the support decision from the learner.
«de nada» is a completely correct courteous reply when someone thanks you.
In ir a + infinitive the preposition a must never be dropped in careful usage: va a llover, not «va llover».
Feminine nouns beginning with stressed a take «el» in the singular but stay feminine, so adjectives agree in the feminine: el agua fría.
té (noun 'infusion') carries a diacritic tilde; te (pronoun) does not.

labels.wrongElement: accepted key "mi" and error variant "mí" marked incorrect with feedback "односкладові слова … пишуться без тильди"
labels.expectedFinding: The personal pronoun mí (after a preposition: para mí) carries a diacritic tilde, unlike the possessive mi.

labels.wrongElement: accepted variant v2 "habían" (noteUk claims agreement with «muchas personas») is accepted as correct for existential haber
labels.expectedFinding: Existential haber is impersonal and stays singular: «había muchas personas», not «habían».
lo is the direct object for a male person; le is also admitted for male persons (leísmo de persona), more often in the singular.
«hecho» is the irregular participle of hacer (FundéuRAE lists it with roto as an irregular participle).
imprimir has two participles; impreso and imprimido are both adequate in compound tenses (impreso more frequent).

labels.wrongElement: error variant e1 "freído" marked incorrect with feedback claiming freír has only «frito»
labels.expectedFinding: freír has two participles; both freído and frito are adequate in compound tenses («He freído/frito un huevo»).
